bounds.family: periodic tableau (separate alphabets) then columnar transposition
bounds.route_set: plain columnar w=2..96 x {ltr, rtl} x {fwd, inv}; keyed columnar from each vocabulary word x {fwd, inv}; double plain columnar w1,w2 in 2..50
bounds.periods: 1-97 by divisor rule on plaintext positions
bounds.key_pool: vocabulary words and K1-K3 windows of length P for live P <= 30
